description: T-Bank VoiceKit is the speech recognition and synthesis API of T-Bank (formerly Tinkoff), a Moscow-based Russian bank, sold through T-Bank Software (developer.tbank.ru). Recognition is trained on Russian call-centre speech and billed per second in roubles; the team also publishes the T-one streaming Russian telephony ASR model as Apache-2.0 open weights. Accounts are created on T-Bank Software and billed monthly in roubles.
name: T-Bank VoiceKit
